title: RepTate GUI Workflow Map
description: Interactive documentation data for major RepTate GUI flows between packages, classes, and runtime components.

components.name: RepTate entry point
components.summary: Creates the PySide6 QApplication and then instantiates the GUI application manager.

components.name: QApplication / Qt event loop
components.summary: Owns the GUI event loop and dispatches QAction, tab, and widget signals.

components.name: QApplicationManager
components.summary: Top-level RepTate window. Registers available application classes, opens application tabs, saves projects, and routes help/log actions.

components.name: Application* subclasses
components.summary: Domain-specific applications such as MWD, LVE, NLVE, Crystal, React, Dielectric, LAOS, and others.

components.name: QApplicationWindow
components.summary: Base GUI application window. Owns views, file types, datasets, tools, matplotlib canvases, and application-level actions.

components.name: MultiView
components.summary: Creates and manages the matplotlib Figure, axes array, canvas, and plot layout used by an application.

components.name: View
components.summary: Transforms raw or theory tables into display x/y arrays, labels, scaling, and view-specific plot semantics.

components.name: QDataSet
components.summary: Dataset tab widget. Owns files, current theory selection, theory tabs, dataset tree, and dataset-level plot refreshes.

components.name: DataSetWidget
components.summary: Tree widget used to display files and file parameters inside a dataset.

components.name: FileType
components.summary: Application-specific file parser and metadata definition. Converts disk files into File objects.

components.name: File
components.summary: Represents one loaded data file, including file parameters, active state, theory x-range settings, and a DataTable.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: Stores numeric arrays and matplotlib series for data, theory, and transformed view data.

components.name: Application theory registry
components.summary: Ordered mapping from user-visible theory names to concrete QTheory subclasses available in an application.

components.name: QTheory
components.summary: Base GUI theory. Owns parameters, theory tables, calculation/fitting actions, error metrics, and output text.

components.name: Theory* subclasses
components.summary: Scientific model implementations. Each subclass defines parameters, calculation function, optional extra UI, and references.

components.name: Parameter
components.summary: Stores theory parameter value, bounds, optimization type, display flags, and unit metadata.

components.name: SciPy optimizers
components.summary: Used by QTheory.do_fit for least-squares and global minimization methods.

components.name: QTool / Tool*
components.summary: Optional data and theory processing tools applied during plotting.

components.name: matplotlib canvas
components.summary: Receives updated line data from DataTable series and redraws the application plots.

components.name: Project JSON in .rept zip
components.summary: Project save/load representation containing apps, datasets, files, theories, parameter values, tables, and tool state.

flows.label: Create Application
flows.summary: A toolbar QAction creates an application-specific QApplicationWindow subclass, gives it an empty dataset, and adds it as a tab.

steps.payload: app_name such as MWD, LVE, TTS, React, or LAOS
Generated application name, parent manager, logger context
Application-specific views, file types, theory registry additions
Figure, axes array, canvas, event bindings
Initial dataset tab named and attached to the new application
Widget ownership moves to the manager tab widget

flows.label: New Dataset From File
flows.summary: Selected files are parsed through the application file type and added as File/DataTable objects to the current dataset before plotting.

steps.payload: List of filesystem paths chosen by the user
Current dataset, blocked tree signals during import
File parameters, column definitions, unit-aware parameter specs
Filename, file type, parent dataset, axes array
Numeric NumPy array plus matplotlib series handles
Visible file rows, file parameters, active check states
View-transformed x/y data and line styling

flows.label: New Theory
flows.summary: The current dataset creates a concrete theory from the application theory registry, optionally calculates it, and shows it in a theory tab.

steps.payload: Selected cbtheory text, with first selectable theory as fallback
Theory user-visible name and current dataset state
Theory id, parent dataset, application axes array
Parameter dictionary, theory tables, widgets, calculation function
Values, bounds, optimization flags, units, display metadata

steps.call: Initialize theory tables keyed by file_name_short
steps.payload: One theory DataTable per file in the dataset
New active theory tab and visible theory curves
Theory line data and updated plot canvas

flows.label: Calculate Theory
flows.summary: The active theory evaluates its scientific function over active files, fills theory DataTables, computes errors, and redraws.

steps.payload: Current theory name and active files
Busy/stop state, single-file guard, calculate icon state
Active File objects, optional extended theory x-range
Calculated y columns, extra tables where needed
Theory table transformed into view-specific display arrays
Error metric text, reset busy flags and toolbar icons
Updated matplotlib series data

flows.label: Minimize
flows.summary: The dataset delegates fitting to the active theory, which calls SciPy optimizers, updates parameters, recalculates theory tables, and refreshes the plot.

steps.payload: Current theory, files, stop/busy state
Disabled new-theory button, disabled theory buttons, fit icon as stop
Parameters with opt_type, current values, bounds, optional sigma/error settings
Objective function, selected MinimizationMethod, active file data
Best-fit parameter vector, covariance/error estimates where available
Updated Parameter values used by scientific model function

steps.call: Update theory tables and parameter table
steps.payload: Fitted theory output and parameter display values
Visible fitted curves and reset fit busy state

flows.label: Change View
flows.summary: Changing the active view reprocesses data and theory tables through View.view_proc before updating line data on the canvas.

steps.payload: Selected View object and plot layout state
Active files, inactive files, active theory flags
Raw data table and file parameters converted to display arrays
View arrays, axes, file parameters, data/theory selection
Matplotlib line objects owned by File and QTheory DataTables
Axes limits, legend, visible line state, canvas redraw

flows.label: New Tool
flows.summary: Application-level tool creation attaches a QTool/Tool subclass to the app and lets it transform data or theory arrays during plotting.

steps.payload: Selected tool name and current application
Tool id, application parent, optional tool UI
Datasets re-run plotting with active tools in order

steps.call: calculate_all(view.n, x, y, axes, color, file_parameters)
steps.payload: Transformed display arrays for data and optionally theory
Tool-modified curves rendered on the canvas

flows.label: Save Project
flows.summary: The manager serializes open applications, datasets, files, theories, parameters, theory tables, and tools into the project JSON stored inside a .rept archive.

steps.payload: Target .rept file path
Application tab names and application class names
Dataset tab names, files, theories, tools
Filename, active state, file parameters, table data, theory x-range controls
Theory name, parameter values, tables, extra tables, extra data
Serializable lists and dictionaries, preserving tab order
Project archive representation used by load_project
